code.pseudocode: A distribution lists the possible values and how likely each is. The probabilities add up to 1.
Bernoulli(p): the value 1 has probability p and the value 0 has probability 1 - p.
Binomial(n, p): the number of successes in n independent Bernoulli trials.
Uniform on [0, 1]: the density is the same at every point of the range.
The Gaussian is highest at its mean and about 68% of its values lie within one standard deviation.
Each distribution has a mean that summarizes its center.
code.python:
p = 0.3
print(p, round(10 * p, 1), 0.5, 0.0)   # means: Bernoulli 0.3, Binomial 3.0, Uniform 0.5, Gaussian 0.0
